brief:
Israeli occupation forces carried out demolition and leveling operations in Qalundia village, north of Jerusalem, the Ma'an news agency reported. Video documentation showed heavy machinery at work in the residential area during the operation.

The village, situated in territory near the capital, has experienced repeated Israeli military incursions and construction activity. Palestinian residents have long protested demolitions in the area, citing displacement and loss of property. Details on the specific number of structures targeted and the stated justification for the operation remained unclear at the time of reporting.
title: Israeli forces demolish structures in Qalundia north of Jerusalem
